construction.note: explicit labels instead of v1 relative references; list labels lowercase (`lst1(1)`) because an uppercase-initial label before `(` reads as a command head in this grammar (`L1(1)` -> UnknownHead); `{Tangent(C, c)}` is a raw list Definition (brace) so Tangent is not seen by the closed world

ir_reads_initial.note: D/E come from `D = lst1(1)` (an expression, not a command): the IR shows no command for them; F/G are NaN at the start because C = A makes c2 = Circle(Midpoint(A, C), A) degenerate
